sources.title: baerquants/Inkling-Small-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 1. General Information Inkling-Small is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text, image and audio inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages. sources.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model - Thinking Machines Lab
sources.snippet: Inkling reasons natively over text, images, and audio, and balances cost with performance through efficient and controllable thinking effort. We trained it to be a broad, balanced foundation model: strong across many domains, flexible enough to adapt. Inkling is not the strongest overall model available today, open or closed.
